kafka_readiness.scope: successful Kafka cluster and topic metadata requests

acceptance: availableNow drains and final observed source lag is zero
all finalized features have predictions from the selected numerical model version
24h variants have identical canonical features and scores within 1e-12
each 24h variant persists nonzero alerts and exercises cooldown suppression
24h variants have identical alert business bodies and per-prediction cooldown outcomes
alert evidence matches persisted features and the cooldown schedule matches business availability times
requested topic partitions and actual Spark launch master agree
training source, artifacts and implementation source remain unchanged

alert_comparison.actual_schema_note: current alert bodies contain predicted_at_epoch, inference_ms and arrival_to_prediction_ms; no created_at
alert_comparison.comparison: exact canonical hashes and equality of alert identities, evidence, observations, score, threshold, model and cooldown outcomes
alert_comparison.cooldown: for every above-threshold prediction, record emitted/not_emitted from persisted alert membership; independently replay the configured cooldown in business availability order
alert_comparison.retained: all persisted alert body fields except explicitly listed execution timing fields; event_time and available_at remain

protocol.input_reuse: all three 24h variants use the identical JSONL bytes
protocol.interpretation: four sequential single observations; cold JVM each time, shared warm services/OS cache; no statistical speedup, Big Data, multi-node, cost, Databricks, or real-plant claim

resource_scope.children_rusage: OS CPU delta for reaped children, separately reported; do not add to sampled child CPU
resource_scope.cpu: sampled per-process user+system CPU deltas; short-lived processes and final sampling tails may be missed
resource_scope.rss: sampled resident bytes; simultaneous sums double-count shared pages and are not total host memory
resource_scope.runner_cpu: exact process_time delta for benchmark Python, including producer and sampler threads
resource_scope.window: publication start through worker completion; services already started

protocol.scope: one host; real JVM Kafka, local Spark, HTTP MLflow and SQLite sink; synthetic data

timing_scope.end_to_end: Kafka record timestamp to prediction; includes intentionally preloaded backlog and JVM startup
timing_scope.inference: stored model.predict latency, including feature DataFrame conversion
timing_scope.query_elapsed: stream() receipt elapsed; excludes initial SparkSession construction
timing_scope.throughput: raw sink rows / fresh worker wall time, including Python/JVM startup and shutdown

protocol.training: copy stopped MLflow and training state; compare hashes and training source; no retraining or promotion
